name: Common Crawl
description: URL-pattern search over Common Crawl indexes (no keyword full-text search). The q parameter is a URL pattern like *.example.com/*, not a keyword query.

index_id.description: Common Crawl index id, e.g. CC-MAIN-2024-50. Defaults to 'latest'.

crawl.description: Alias for index_id; explicit crawl identifier such as CC-MAIN-2024-50.
